messages.subject: Annotation in a facet_grid plot
parts:
Dear Community,

I create a facet_grid plot like following:
ggplot(loc,aes(richness,RueN))+geom_point(size=3)+facet_grid(treat~patch)+xlab("Species richness")+ylab("Log RueN")+
theme_bw()+
theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=16, face="plain", colour="black",vjust=0.3),axis.text.y=element_text(size=12,face="bold",colour="black"))+
theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=16,face="plain",colour="black"),axis.text.x=element_text(size=12,face="bold",colour="black"))+
theme(axis.ticks=element_line(colour="black",size=1),axis.ticks.length=unit(0.3,"cm"))+
theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black",size=1.3))+
theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor=element_blank())+
geom_smooth(method="lm")

and get this figure (see below) but I would like to annotate only the first plot for grad and uniform (1, grad and 1, uniform). More specifically, I would delete the the strip.text.y (uniform and grad at the side)
instead I would label the first plot of the uniform and grad panel with "Uniform" and "Gradient". The annotation command labeled all plots and using geom_tex() by creating a new label dataframe as suggested in the ggplot2 community didn´t work
here.

So any ideas.

Thanks in advance,
Nils
